inputs.name: cyclical_pain_ratio_90d
inputs.description: Share of pain days occurring within 3 days before/after a cycle start (0-1).

inputs.name: dyschezia
inputs.description: Any reported pain with bowel movements in the last 90 days.

evidence.title: Endometriosis: diagnosis and management (NG73)
evidence.note: Cyclical pain with dyschezia is a recognised endometriosis indicator (all ages 13+). Draft thresholds pending Kenyan clinician sign-off. Dyspareunia is handled by endo-indicator-adult (min_age 18).

changelog.note: Initial draft from published guidance. clinically_validated=false pending Kenyan clinician sign-off.
